rules: 1. Read daily regime verdict from akme_alpha.db regime_daily table. 2. Map regime to sector allocation: Expansion (tech/cyclical), Recovery (value/quality), Slowdown (defensive/duration), Recession (duration/gold/cash). 3. Rebalance to target allocation on regime change. 4. Hold position until next regime shift.

Expansion.description: Growth leader — tech and cyclicals outperform

Recovery.description: Value rotation — financials and dividend payers lead

Slowdown.description: Defensive rotation — quality and duration lead

biases: Price data not available for historical simulation (no price_daily data for most tickers)
Max DD 68% indicates model needs refinement
One regime switch in 365 days suggests regime changes are rare
Composite score stuck at +0.461 for Recovery (Shiller CAPE data dominates)
Look-ahead: z-scores use prior data, not current day

comparison_to_other_strategies.note: Regime positioning is a data-limited pilot. The 365-day history shows 361 days of Recovery vs 4 days of Slowdown. The +0.461 composite suggests Recovery mode, but this is driven primarily by Shiller CAPE data. The model needs refinement to produce meaningful backtest results.
